bolus-reduction/abstracts/braune-2022-la.title: Braune et al., Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2022: open-source AID consensus - enter all carbs incl. hypo treatment; bolus before meals; fewer carbs after long suspension; DIA 5-7 h; target 110-120 mg/dL

bolus-reduction/abstracts/brodows-1984-j.title: Brodows et al., JAMA 1984: at 55 mg/dL clamp, 20 g D-glucose corrected hypo for ≥40 min; 40 g juice ≈ 20 g glucose; 20 g carbs as whole milk raised only ~1 mmol/L (ISPAD citation)

bolus-reduction/abstracts/buchanan-2021-.title: Buchanan 2021 JDST: Omnipod (reverse correction ON), 670G (reduces by default), t:slim (Reduce Bolus Calc prompt) with identical settings; below target doses differed up to 10-fold (0.15 vs 1.5 U for BG 75 + 30 g); t:slim subtracts IOB and negative correction, 670G only the negative correction

bolus-reduction/abstracts/cappon-2018-jd.title: Cappon 2018 JDST in silico: neural-network bolus using CGM ROC lowered BGRI by 0.37 vs standard formula, 0.23 vs Scheiner, 0.20 vs Pettus/Edelman (p<0.001); proof of concept only

bolus-reduction/abstracts/cappon-2019-jd.title: Cappon 2019 JDST in silico (100 adults, 75 g): trend-adjusted bolus beats standard formula on average; with ROC -3..-2 mg/dL/min Pettus/Edelman best (BGRI 8.36 vs 12.88 at 100 mg/dL); slow falls inconsistent; upward adjustments raise hypo risk

bolus-reduction/abstracts/cobry-2010-dtt.title: Cobry et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2010: bolus −20 min beat 0 and +20 min (AUC 159.5 vs 187.0 vs 184.5 mg/dL); 0 and +20 min equal; most hypo episodes with +20 min (5 vs 1 vs 4); pre-meal glucose had to be in range

bolus-reduction/abstracts/danne-2003-dia.title: Danne et al., Diabetes Care 2003: in 76 children/adolescents on MDI, aspart given right after the meal (≤30 min) was non-inferior for HbA1c; hypo RR 1.1 (ns); only 2-h post-breakfast glucose ~2.1 mmol/L higher

bolus-reduction/abstracts/davidson-2008-.title: Davidson et al., Endocr Pract 2008: AIM formulas CF = 1700/TDD, CIR = 2.8 × weight(lb)/TDD → implied carb sensitivity ≈276/weight(kg) mg/dL per g (≈9 for 30 kg, ≈3.7 for 74 kg; our arithmetic)

bolus-reduction/abstracts/direcnet-2008-.title: DirecNet Study Group, Pediatr Diabetes 2008: paediatric pump algorithm: cut the calculated meal dose 10% (angle-down) or 20% (down); at <=70 mg/dL eat first and bolus the full meal once glucose is >80 mg/dL

bolus-reduction/abstracts/grassi-2026-dt.title: Grassi et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2026: 780G adults, 60 g meal - 50% bolus at +60 min TIR 63.5% vs 52.3% no bolus vs 85.5% pre-meal, no more <54 mg/dL

bolus-reduction/abstracts/gross-2003-dtt.title: Gross 2003 DTT: crossover n=49 CSII, 7 days/arm; calculator (BG vs target, ICR, ISF) -> fewer correction boluses (p=0.008) and less carbohydrate for lows (p=0.046), same 2-h post-meal deviation

bolus-reduction/abstracts/husband-2010-p.title: Husband et al., Pediatr Diabetes 2010: in 33 children, sucrose (Skittles) = glucose tablets for hypo at 15 min; fructose (fruit leather) clearly less effective

bolus-reduction/abstracts/king-2007-jdst.title: King & Armstrong, J Diabetes Sci Technol 2007: in 30 CGM-titrated adult pump users CF ≈ 4.44 × ICR, i.e. carb sensitivity ≈4.4 mg/dL per gram; ICR = 217/TDD + 3, CF = 1076/TDD + 12

bolus-reduction/abstracts/klonoff-2017-j.title: Klonoff & Kerr, J Diabetes Sci Technol 2017: fixed -1/-1.5/-2 U for falls of 1-2/2-3/>3 mg/dL/min over a 45-min horizon; not for children or adults using <20-29 U/day; Scheiner adds 25% or 50-100% more carbs when falling

bolus-reduction/abstracts/mctavish-2011-.title: McTavish & Wiltshire, Pediatr Diabetes 2011: 0.3 g/kg fast carbs resolved most hypos in 39 children (191 episodes); median rise ~1–1.3 mmol/L at 10 min, ~2 mmol/L at 15 min; jellybeans slower

bolus-reduction/abstracts/mctavish-2018-.title: McTavish et al., Diabet Med 2018: in pump users 6–68 y, 0.3 g/kg glucose beat 10 g (children)/15 g (adults): +0.45 mmol/L at 10 min in children, OR 2.61 for single-dose resolution

bolus-reduction/abstracts/messer-2019-dt.title: Messer et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2019: CARES framework - treat lows with 5-10 g after insulin suspension; pre-bolus; do not override Control-IQ bolus calculator

bolus-reduction/abstracts/noaro-2023-jds.title: Noaro 2023 JDST in silico (7 trend-arrow methods): for falling glucose all reductions raised TIR and lowered TBR; at mealtime 80 mg/dL standard formula TBR 18.6% vs ~5% with KL/PE/BR; increases for rising arrows overdose

bolus-reduction/abstracts/pettus-2016-dt.title: Pettus & Edelman, Diabetes Technol Ther 2016: survey of 222 adult T1D CGM users: meal bolus at 110 mg/dL with double-down arrows cut by 44% (pump) and 55% (MDI), far more than the 10-20% rule

bolus-reduction/abstracts/russo-2005-jce.title: Russo et al., JCEM 2005 (+Schvarcz 1995): hypoglycaemia (~2.6 mmol/L) speeds gastric emptying of solids and liquids in T1D; healthy T50 43→16 min (solids)

bolus-reduction/abstracts/rutledge-1997-.title: Rutledge et al., Pediatrics 1997: in toddlers <5 y, lispro after the meal gave similar 2-h excursions to lispro before and better than pre-meal regular insulin (n = 10)

bolus-reduction/abstracts/santova-2026-d.title: Santova et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2026: children, 30/50 g with no bolus - time >250 mg/dL 5/21% (780G), 9.9/26% (Control-IQ), 26/42% (CamAPS)

bolus-reduction/abstracts/scaramuzza-201.title: Scaramuzza et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2010 (TiBoDi): in 30 pump children 1-h glucose 177 (after meal) vs 136 (−15 min) vs 130 mg/dL (just before); authors say pre-bolus even if hypo, but only 80–140 mg/dL starts were studied

bolus-reduction/abstracts/schmidt-2014-j.title: Schmidt & Norgaard 2014 JDST review: formula (meal + correction) x physiological factor - IOB; pumps subtract IOB only from the correction; one RCT without IOB had more severe hypos; no data on reverse correction

bolus-reduction/abstracts/sherr-2023-dia.title: Sherr et al., Diabetologia 2023 (EASD/ADA AID consensus): late full meal bolus can cause hypoglycaemia, post-meal bolus may need reducing; fewer carbs for lows; highs 30-40 min after a treated low

bolus-reduction/abstracts/vinals-2021-jc.title: Viñals et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2021 (+Mesa 2023): closed loop with automatic prediction-based 15 g carb suggestions cut exercise time <70 mg/dL from 16.2% to 0% with fewer total carbs (adults, n = 10)

bolus-reduction/abstracts/walsh-2011-jds.title: Walsh 2011 JDST: 396 Cozmo pumps; calculator cut 1.40 U/day for bolus-on-board and 0.27 U/day for hypoglycaemia vs 0.09 U/day user reductions; BOB should be subtracted from carb and correction doses; CF=1960/TDD, CarbF=5.7xkg/TDD, DIA 4.5-6 h

bolus-reduction/abstracts/wiethop-1993-d.title: Wiethop & Cryer, Diabetes Care 1993: in adult T1D hypoglycaemia (3.0–3.3 mmol/L) 10 g glucose peaked at 5.4 mmol/L within 30 min, 20 g at 6.8 mmol/L within 45 min (~+40 / ~+65 mg/dL), then waned

bolus-reduction/abstracts/ziegler-2019-j.title: Ziegler et al., J Diabetes Sci Technol 2019: German scorecards adjust bolus by arrow, CF and current glucose band (<70/70-180/180-250/>250); below 70 mg/dL give 1-2 fast-acting carb units instead of insulin; children get fractional decrements; with PLGS rely on pump suspend for falling arrows

bolus-reduction/abstracts/zisser-2008-dt.title: Zisser 2008 DTT (abstract only): four pumps with the same settings calculate doses 'in a slightly different way', mainly IOB handling; below-target per-pump details not verifiable

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC10002216.md.title: Parise et al., Int J Environ Res Public Health 2023: crossover in 20 adults (Dexcom G6), Ziegler scorecard raised TIR to 69.0% vs 65.8% with DirecNet +/-10/20% and 59.0% baseline, no severe hypos; AID users excluded

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC10108244.md.title: ISPAD 2022: Managing diabetes in preschoolers (excerpt: bolus dosing, hybrid closed loop, meals, hypoglycaemia)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC11183505.md.title: Zucchini et al., Front Endocrinol 2024 (Italian pediatric): on HCL/AHCL treat lows with 4-8 g (0.1-0.15 g/kg), wait 15 min; treat only if symptomatic or within 2-3 h of a bolus with excess IOB; goal >70 mg/dL

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC12977992.md.title: Prince et al. 2026: Systematic review of oral carbohydrate amounts for non-severe hypoglycaemia in T1D, closed loop vs other insulin regimens

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC13615190.md.title: Gupta et al. 2026: Diabetes technology in the school setting for preschool-aged children (excerpt: AID, meals, activity, hypo/hyperglycaemia)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC2945151.md.title: Luijf et al. 2010: Bolus 30, 15 or 0 minutes before a meal and post-meal glucose in type 1 diabetes

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC5375074.md.title: Pettus & Edelman 2017: Using real-time CGM trend arrows for prandial and correction insulin doses in type 1 diabetes

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC5760209.md.title: Laffel et al. 2017: Using Dexcom G5 trend arrows to adjust insulin doses in children and adolescents (Endocrine Society approach)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC5760210.md.title: Aleppo et al. 2017: Using Dexcom G5 trend arrows to adjust insulin doses in adults (Endocrine Society approach)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC5836969.md.title: Slattery et al. 2018: Optimal prandial timing of bolus insulin in diabetes management, a review

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC6243139.md.title: Kudva et al. 2018: Using trend arrows of the FreeStyle Libre systems to adjust insulin doses in adults (Endocrine Society panel)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC7780381.md.title: Rodacki et al., Diabetol Metab Syndr 2021: Brazilian Diabetes Society endorses Ziegler scorecards for MDI/open-loop pumps; with PLGS use only upward arrows, with hybrid/full closed loop avoid arrow-based dose changes (use arrows for post-meal checks and carb amounts)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC8252907.md.title: Pinsker et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2021: PLGS lows after meals rescued with 9.9 +/- 4.8 g (5-16 g), glucose +54.5 mg/dL; suspensions averted ~7 g carbs; revisit 15-20 g rule

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC8671682.md.title: Elbarbary et al. 2021: Use of CGM trend arrows in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes (ASPED consensus)

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC8739578.md.title: Boughton et al., J Diabetes Sci Technol 2022: Cambridge closed-loop training - reduce or skip a late meal bolus (loop insulin already given); ~4 g carbs can prevent/treat level 1 lows on closed loop

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC9781659.md.title: Mozzillo et al., J Pers Med 2022: pediatric systematic review — pre-meal bolus (−20 to −10 min) lowers 1–2 h peak without more hypos; post-meal fast-acting analogues acceptable for young unpredictable eaters; no trial tested bolus timing when pre-meal glucose was low

bolus-reduction/articles/PMC9985411.md.title: Phillip et al. 2023: ATTD consensus on automated insulin delivery in clinical practice (systems, set-up, meals, hypo, exercise, sick days)

bolus-reduction/devices/androidaps-bolus.title: AndroidAPS Bolus Wizard (docs + code, AGPL): BG below range corrected to the LOW end (negative), optional 15-min trend = shortAvgDelta x3 / ISF (off by default), IOB subtracted; negative total -> 0 U and carbs required = deficit x IC; percentage (default 100%) only on positive totals

bolus-reduction/devices/education-diabet.title: Diabetes Education Services blog ~2023 (education): BG 67 before a 45 g/3 U meal — treat 15 g then full dose, OR reduce bolus ~1 U (15 g uncovered) and eat at once, OR bolus after the meal; all acceptable

bolus-reduction/devices/education-eoe-cy.title: East of England CYP Diabetes Network guideline 2023 (education): 0.3 g/kg expected +3–4 mmol/L; hypo before meal → recover to >4 mmol/L, give meal insulin and eat immediately (no 10–15 min wait)

bolus-reduction/devices/education-nation.title: Nationwide Children's school orders (education): low at meal → 15 g until >70 mg/dL, then usual meal insulin for the meal carbs; no correction within 3 h of a low

bolus-reduction/devices/education-ruh-ba.title: RUH Bath leaflet 2023 (education): sensor <4 mmol/L while eating a meal usually needs no hypo treatment unless symptomatic or <3.5 mmol/L with a down arrow; doses 3/5/10/15 g by age

bolus-reduction/devices/education-us-chi.title: Children's Health Dallas 2023 + Diabetes Self-Management 2017 (education): do not pre-bolus when low before a meal; one tip: inject 15 min after the first bite

bolus-reduction/devices/education-worces.title: Worcestershire NHS Trust guideline 2024 (education): 0.3 g/kg (5–15 g), AID half/5–10 g, expect +3–4 mmol/L; hypo before a meal → treat, then usual meal insulin once >4.0 mmol/L

bolus-reduction/devices/education-wustl-.title: Washington University Diabetes Team handout 2020 (education): low before eating → treat with 15 g, then dose for the meal carbs; do not count hypo-treatment carbs in the mealtime dose

bolus-reduction/devices/loop-bolus-recom.title: Loop (LoopDocs + LoopAlgorithm MIT): forecast over 6 h(+10 min); smallest dose bringing every point to a target that equals the Glucose Safety Limit for the first 50% of DIA then rises to the correction midpoint; any point below the safety limit (guardrail 67-110, typical 74-80 mg/dL) -> 0; meal bolus reduced implicitly

bolus-reduction/devices/oref-determine-b.title: oref0 determine-basal (MIT): threshold=(min_bg+40)/2 (Trio clamps 60-120, default 60), predBGs 48x5 min = 4 h, minPredBG waits 90 min, minGuardBG<threshold -> SMB off + 30-120 min zero temp, carbsReq=(threshold-naiveEventualBG-zeroTempEffect)/CSF - (COB-25% carbs), shown if >=threshold g and low within 45 min

bolus-reduction/devices/trio-bolus-calcu.title: Trio source (main 0b29cd5, v1.0.2): calculator = (BG-target)/ISF + 15-20 min delta/ISF + (COB+carbs)/CR - IOB, all negatives subtracted before the percentage; forced to 0 if BG <54, oref minPredBG <54 (simulated with typed meal) or loop >15 min old; carbsReq not used by the calculator

correction-up/abstracts/akturk-2022-dtt-.title: Akturk et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2022: Control-IQ adults with almost no boluses - A1c -1.6 %, TIR +19.3 points, no rise in time below range (n=30)

correction-up/abstracts/arrieta-2022-dom.title: Arrieta et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022: 780G in 3211 children <=15 y - auto-corrections 15 % of TDD (~25 % of boluses); target 100 vs 110 mg/dL: TIR 78.9 vs 76.5 % but time <70 3.6 vs 2.7 %

correction-up/abstracts/berget-2020-jdst.title: Berget et al., JDST 2020: paediatric 670G HCL training (n=72): TIR 49->62 %, 5.8 exits/week mostly high glucose (>250 mg/dL 3 h or >300 mg/dL 1 h), correction-bolus re-teaching needed in 48 %, ICR strengthened +24 %

correction-up/abstracts/braune-2022-lanc.title: Braune et al., Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2022 (open-source AID consensus), corrections: log pen insulin in the system; after set failure inject the undelivered IOB; ketones: set change + profile 30-200 % until <0.6 mmol/L; DIA 5-7 h; no need to stop AID when ill

correction-up/abstracts/burnside-2022-ne.title: Burnside et al., NEJM 2022: CREATE RCT, AndroidAPS/OpenAPS in 97 children and adults - TIR +14 points vs SAP, no severe hypoglycaemia, same effect in children

correction-up/abstracts/castaneda-2022-d.title: Castañeda et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022: 780G (12,870 users) - higher auto-correction dose predicts lower TIR; AIT 2 h + target 100 best TIR, AIT not linked to time <70

correction-up/abstracts/cescon-2016-jdst.title: Cescon et al., JDST 2016: CGM+pump algorithm flagged infusion set failure 2.5 days early (50 % sensitivity, 66 % specificity); could cut time >180 mg/dL by 29 %; cited by ATTD consensus for its set-failure rule

correction-up/abstracts/chatty-2026-diab.title: Chatty et al., Diabetes Care 2026: youth with <=3 boluses/day - Control-IQ (auto-corrections) TIR 54.9 % vs Omnipod 5 46.9 % (+8 points)

correction-up/abstracts/hanas-2017-jdst-.title: Hanas & Adolfsson, JDST 2017: 21 prepubertal children on pumps: titrated DIA 2.6 h (calculator artefact), correction rule 113-120 by day vs 200 at night (~40 % less correction insulin at night), breakfast ICR rule 211

correction-up/abstracts/messer-2021-pedi.title: Messer et al., Pediatr Diabetes 2021: pediatric Control-IQ check-in (123 youth) - tool tells educators to discourage bolus overrides when hypoglycaemia >5 %

correction-up/abstracts/nct07179471-chea.title: NCT07179471 CHeatAID (registration, no results): fake-carbs crossover in 40 children on 780G [unverified claim of no benefit]

correction-up/abstracts/nimri-2021-dtt-a.title: Nimri et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2021: Medtronic AHCL with automated corrections in 12 adolescents - TIR 68.4 to 74 %, time <70 4 to 2.6 %, night TIR 80.7 %

correction-up/abstracts/niu-2026-diabete.title: Niu et al., Diabetes Care 2026: 780G days with no user boluses (54,553 users) - TIR 76.3 %, time <70 0.8 % with target 100/AIT 2 h

correction-up/abstracts/papa-2026-jdst-7.title: Papa et al., J Diabetes Sci Technol 2026 (2 papers, 287 users): 780G auto-corrections 18.3 % of TDD, 33.1 % of boluses; share >20.3 % predicts TIR <70 %; AIT 2 h more auto-correction, better TIR

correction-up/abstracts/petruzelkova-202.title: Petruzelkova et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2023: Pancreas4ALL, 16 adolescents on AAPS - time <54 1.05 % with full boluses vs 0.0 % without; TIR 79.9-83.3 % in all modes

correction-up/abstracts/rabbone-2018-dom.title: Rabbone et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2018: 1046 Italian children on pumps, 4.5 failures/person-year; hyperglycaemia fixed by set change most frequent (8.4/person-year), most in preschoolers; lipohypertrophy linked to HbA1c

correction-up/abstracts/rosales-2018-cmp.title: Rosales et al., Comput Methods Programs Biomed 2018: in silico IOB-based super-bolus - 75 g meal euglycaemia 81.9 to 89.5 %, hypoglycaemia 5.9 to 1.0 %

correction-up/abstracts/toffanin-2020-dt.title: Toffanin et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2020: in silico AndroidAPS (oref) - best with SMB + half meal bolus (TIR 91 %, 54-70 <1 %); +/-50 % bolus errors did not change TIR or lows

correction-up/abstracts/walsh-2014-jdst-.title: Walsh, Roberts, Heinemann, JDST 2014: DIA 4.5-6.5 h (6-6.5 h for >0.2 U/kg); children 3.5-6.9 y show insulin action >=5 h; 3 h DIA hides 2.5-4.7 U of a 10 U bolus at 3 h and causes stacking, especially in children

correction-up/abstracts/welch-2025-jdst-.title: Welch et al., J Diabetes Sci Technol 2025 (case): 780G auto-corrections 2.44-2.94 U after temp target ended during a falling high caused 3 lows <70 within 3 h

correction-up/articles/PMC10698772.md.title: Messer & Breton, Diabetes Technol Ther 2023: 20,764 Control-IQ users - more user boluses = higher TIR but more hypoglycaemia; aggressive ISF +14 points TIR with only +0.15 % time <70

correction-up/articles/PMC10818731.md.title: Kowalczyk-Korcz et al., Nutrients 2024: RCT 72 children on pumps - super bolus (+50 % meal dose, basal off 2 h) TIR 91.7 vs 84.7 % but more lows (meter <70: 33 vs 14), 2.5-3 h after

correction-up/articles/PMC11307210.md.title: Ware et al., J Diabetes Sci Technol 2024: CamAPS 'Boost' (+35 % algorithm insulin) on high days did not raise hypoglycaemia (time <70 3.18 % vs 3.28 %), ages 1-80; offered as safer than manual corrections

correction-up/articles/PMC11538916.md.title: Szadkowska et al. 2024: Polish paediatric guidelines (PTEiDD / PTD) on hybrid closed-loop insulin therapy in children and adolescents

correction-up/articles/PMC11571990.md.title: Singh et al., J Diabetes Sci Technol 2025: Control-IQ/780G real world (142 adults) - 2 of 4 severe hypos caused by self-given corrections on top of auto-corrections

correction-up/articles/PMC12881006.md.title: Lal et al., Diabetologia 2026: open-source oref/SMB without meal announcement - Pancreas4ALL and CLOSE-IT (TIR 66 vs 69 %, non-inferior); review of SMB/UAM

correction-up/articles/PMC8501470.md.title: Breton & Kovatchev, Diabetes Technol Ther 2021: Control-IQ one-year real world (9451 users); auto-correction = 60 % of correction to 110 mg/dL, max hourly; time <70 ~1 %

correction-up/articles/PMC8817690.md.title: Da Silva et al., Diabetes Technol Ther 2022: 780G real world (4120 users) - auto-corrections 14.1 % of TDD, 25.6 % of boluses; user boluses fell 6.0 to 4.8/day; time <70 2.6 to 2.2 %

correction-up/articles/PMC9160549.md.title: Berget et al. 2022: Clinical implementation of the Omnipod 5 AID system — training, onboarding, corrections and troubleshooting

correction-up/articles/PMC9399331.md.title: Lewis & Hussain 2022: Practical guidance on open-source and commercial AID systems for healthcare professionals (troubleshooting, net IOB)

correction-up/articles/PMC9985411-traini.title: Phillip et al. 2023: ATTD consensus on automated insulin delivery — training, pre-AID education checklist and follow-up

correction-up/devices/androidaps-correct.title: AndroidAPS high side (docs + code, AGPL): wizard adds (BG - top of target)/ISF minus bolus IOB incl. SMB and basal IOB; wizard % (default 100%) also cuts the correction; Super Bolus = +2 h basal with 2-h zero temp; SMB = 50% of insulinReq capped at basal x 30 min (15-120), Auto ISF ratio 0.5-1.0

correction-up/devices/camaps-ilet-diabel.title: CamAPS FX, iLet, Diabeloop: CamAPS no auto boluses (Boost 10 min-12 h 59 min), calculator IOB excludes algorithm insulin so meal boluses without glucose term and corrections 'not too often'; iLet no manual bolus, corrects automatically; Diabeloop automatic correction boluses, meal bolus +/-10%

correction-up/devices/commercial-aid-aut.title: AID comparison of high-side handling: automatic share per step Loop 40%, oref/Trio/AAPS 50%, Control-IQ 60% once/h max 6 U, 780G every 5 min to 120, Omnipod 5 microboluses <=4x adaptive basal, CamAPS none; all calculators add a correction net of IOB incl. automated insulin except CamAPS; guidance: follow calculator, no overrides, site/ketone check for persistent highs

correction-up/devices/education-abcd-dtn.title: ABCD-DTN UK HCL leaflet 2023: >15 mmol/L for >2 h is unusual on HCL - give the pump 1 chance, check ketones, change set; ketones <1.5 stay in loop with calculator corrections; 1.5-3: 10 % TDD by pen, >3: 20 % TDD, exit loop, re-enter 4 h after last pen dose

correction-up/devices/education-nhs-scot.title: NHS Scotland HCL flowchart v2 (2025): >14 mmol/L not responding to corrections -> ketones; <1.5 stay in closed loop, set change, calculator corrections; >=1.5 exit loop, 10-20 % TDD by pen, re-enter 4 h after last pen dose; help after 4 h

correction-up/devices/education-uclh-chi.title: UCLH children's HCL page (2025): change set/Pod if >14 mmol/L for >90 min (set failure main DKA cause); ketones >1.5 mmol/L: manual mode + temp basal + pen corrections

correction-up/devices/education-uhmb-cam.title: UHMB paediatric CamAPS FX guide (2023): avoid manual corrections, 'THINK CANNULA' for unexplained highs; ketones >0.6 mmol/L: leave auto mode, pen insulin, change cannula, restart >=2 h after last pen dose

correction-up/devices/education-whitting.title: Whittington NHS pump leaflet (2023): >13 mmol/L: one pump correction, recheck 1-2 h, no fall -> pen + set change; >15 mmol/L for >2 h change cannula; no sleep within 2 h of a set change

correction-up/devices/loop-correction-an.title: Loop high side (LoopDocs + LoopKit MIT): forecast-based correction incl. all IOB; Automatic Bolus 40% per 5-min cycle (GBPA 20% -> 80% at >=200 mg/dL, Temp Basal ~17%); <=40% x Maximum Bolus per cycle, automatic IOB <= 2 x Maximum Bolus; meal screen shows full amount, remainder auto-delivered

correction-up/devices/medtronic-780g-aut.title: Medtronic 780G SmartGuard (User Guide 2025, Carlson 2022): auto correction up to every 5 min to fixed 120 mg/dL once max auto basal reached (fraction undisclosed), 22% of bolus insulin (66% at night); manual correction only if BG/SG >=120, after active insulin and if basal not sufficient; High SG alert >=250 mg/dL for 3 h

correction-up/devices/omnipod5-smartadju.title: Omnipod 5 (Insulet guides, Berget 2022): no automatic correction bolus, 5-min microboluses up to 400% of adaptive basal (e.g. 4 U/h at TDI 48), target 110-150 mg/dL; SmartBolus subtracts IOB incl. AID insulin; >250 mg/dL -> ketones, Pod change if ketones or no fall 2 h after correction

correction-up/devices/oref-smb-insulinre.title: oref0/Trio SMB code: insulinReq=(min(minPredBG,eventualBG)-target)/ISF net of IOB, capped max_iob-IOB; SMB = 50% (Trio 0.3-0.7) capped at 30 min of basal, floor to 0.1 U, every >=3 min; high temp basal+2xinsulinReq capped min(max_basal,3x max daily,4x current); SMB off with high temp target >100, rise >20% or CGM >12 min old; basal 0.5: ~1.15/1.85/1.95 U of a 2 U need in 15/30/60 min

correction-up/devices/tandem-control-iq-.title: Tandem Control-IQ (User Guide 7.4, FDA DEN190034): automatic correction = 60% of correction to 110 mg/dL when predicted >=180 mg/dL at 30 min, max once/60 min, none within 60 min of any bolus or in Sleep, max 6 U; calculator IOB includes all automated insulin, subtracted only from the correction part

correction-up/devices/trio-bolus-calcula.title: Trio source (main 0b29cd5, v1.0.2): calculator high side = ((BG-target)/ISF + 15-20 min delta/ISF + (COB+carbs)/CR - IOB incl. SMB and temp basal) x Recommended Bolus Percentage 80% (5-150%), reduced bolus 70%, super bolus +100% of 1 h basal, capped Max Bolus 10 U and Max IOB - IOB; 0 U if loop >15 min; insulinReq not in dose, shown as 'Trio would give' = insulinReq x 80%

correction-up/devices/trio-oref-manual-b.title: Manual/remote bolus while SMB active (Trio 0b29cd5 + oref0): IOB up -> insulinReq down -> SMB stops, only 3 min SMB pause, zero temp can undo at most basal rate x time; Trio remote bolus rejected if > Max Bolus, IOB+amount > Max IOB, or SMBs/boluses >=20% of amount since command; OpenAPS docs: never bolus full insulinReq
